For most single-server apps, not yet.

A load balancer spreads incoming traffic across two or more app servers and health-checks them, so it only earns its place once you have a second server. Add one when you outgrow a single box (horizontal scaling) or cannot tolerate one going down (high availability). Before that, make the server bigger.
